chunks: Do not bestow favours in expectation of return,

key_terms.تَسْتَكْثِرُ: Expect to receive more / seek increase

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'do not bestow favours in expectation of return'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a directive for the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to avoid ostentatious charity (riya') and to ensure his giving was purely for Allah's pleasure, a principle extended to the Imams as perfect exemplars of sincerity. It underscores the spiritual discipline of detaching the heart from worldly reciprocity, a key theme in the concept of *Ihsan* (spiritual excellence). This teaching serves as a practical guide for believers to purify their intentions (*niyyah*) when performing acts of worship or charity.
